findings.issue: The module docstring says the transport theorem "is assembled from two declarations already in this repository — `ContractableLaw.measurePreserving_reindex` and `preimage_reindex_eq_of_measurableSet_invariants_of_eventually_add`", but the second is declared in this very file (line 59, moved here by this PR). summary: Two module docstrings misdescribe their file's contents after the move: Tail.lean still claims reindexing material it no longer has, and Transport.lean omits one of the two theorems it declares while calling it a pre-existing external input. The new declaration docstrings are otherwise accurate.
